rows.summary: 11 atomic changes. Adds specific, separate auto liability limits, increasing required coverage. Adds a 24-month minimum duration for business interruption coverage.

oldEvidence.quote: Except as otherwise expressly provided below, you are required to obtain all products from us or sources we approve and according to our specifications.
We may require you to purchase private label products from us or mandatory suppliers in amounts we specify in our Operations Manual.
We and our affiliates reserve the right to become approved suppliers for other items and services.

Comprehensive general liability insurance, including products liability, completed operations, property damage, contractual liability, independent contractors’ liability, owned and non-owned and hired automobile coverage, and personal injury coverage with a combined single limit of at least $1,000,000 (or the amount required by the Franchise Premises landlord if greater than $1,000,000), including umbrella coverage.
Business interruption and lost profit insurance.
Employer Practice liability insurance.
Professional liability/errors and omissions insurance for your groomers with reasonable coverage in your discretion or subject to minimum requirements in our Operations Manual (if applicable).
owned and non-owned and hired automobile coverage
This insurance will be in an amount sufficient to replace the Franchise Premises, if applicable, and your personal property upon loss or damage.

newEvidence.quote: You must purchase all items and services needed for the operation of your franchise either from us, our affiliates, one or more mandatory suppliers, our approved suppliers, or subject to our standards and specifications as we will designate.
You must spend at least $1,000 per calendar quarter on private label products that you purchase from us or our mandatory suppliers.
For the Mobile Grooming concept, you must purchase all shampoos only from us or our designated suppliers unless we otherwise approve in writing.
We and our affiliates reserve the right to become approved or mandatory suppliers for other items and services.

Broad form commercial general liability coverage, on an occurrence form (including premises and operations, products and completed operations, personal & advertising injury, broad form contractual liability, and products liability), against claims for bodily injury, personal injury, including death, and property damage with minimum limits of not less than $1,000,000 per occurrence and $2,000,000 aggregate for each coverage;

Loss of income including extra expense insurance with sufficient limits to cover all ongoing expenses, including future profits, royalty fees, advertising contributions, ordinary payroll for competent personnel and other fixed expenses for a minimum of 24 months from the date of loss;
Employment practices liability insurance with minimum limits of not less than $1,000,000 per occurrence/aggregate including third party endorsement;

Professional (Errors and Omissions) Liability insurance covering Franchisee and its pet groomers for legal liability for damages arising out of the performance of the grooming services with a minimum insurance coverage amount of $1,000,000 per claim and in the aggregate;
Cyber and privacy liability with minimum limits of $50,000, including crisis management and data extortion expense.

Business automobile liability, including bodily injury and property damage coverage for all owned, non-owned and hired vehicles, with limits of not less than $1,000,000 for injuries to persons resulting from any one accident, and $500,000 for property damage resulting from any one accident, or higher as required by governing laws;
All risk property insurance including equipment breakdown for the full replacement cost sufficient to cover all business personal property including contents, equipment, and signs;
